privacyNoticeTitle.message: Ubuzima bwite mu mugereka wa FuzeVPN

privacyNoticeIntro.message: Iri tangazo risobanura amakuru akoreshwa n'uyu mugereka. Ryuzuza politiki rusange y'ubuzima bwite ya FuzeVPN, ihuza ryayo riri hepfo. Kohereza isuzuma ku bushake bitandukanye n'amakuru akenewe kugira ngo winjire kandi ukoreshe VPN.

privacyNoticeService.message: Umugereka uhererekanya na api.fuzevpn.com amakuru yo kwemeza umwirondoro, aya konti, ay'ifatabuguzi, ay'igikoresho n'ay'isesiyo ya porokisi. Porokisi ya VPN itwara urujya n'uruza rw'amakuru rucishwamo. Uku guhuza kugaragariza serivisi yakira metadata y'umuyoboro; iri tangazo nta sezerano ryihariye ritanga ku bijyanye n'ibitabo bya seriveri.

privacyNoticeLocal.message: Ububiko bwa mushakisha bubika isesiyo yawe, amakuru ya konti, ibyo wahisemo, imbuga zisonewe n'umwirondoro w'igikoresho. Ibitabo bya tekiniki bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho mu gihe kigera ku minota 10, kabone n'iyo kohereza raporo byikora bizimye. Inyandiko z'agateganyo z'isuzuma na raporo zitegereje koherezwa zirangira hano nyuma y'amasaha 24; isukura rikorwa iyo umugereka ushoboye gukora.

privacyNoticeIpTitle.message: Igenzura rya IP rusange n'ibigo by'abandi

privacyNoticeIp.message: Kwerekana IP n'isuzuma ry'umuyoboro bivugana na api.ipify.org. Kwerekana IP bishobora gukoresha ipv4.icanhazip.com nk'insimburabuzi. Utanga serivisi yakira IP y'uguhuza n'amakuru asanzwe y'icyifuzo (metadata): IP yawe rusange mu buryo butaziguye, cyangwa IP isohokeramo ya VPN iyo hakoreshejwe porokisi. Ibi byifuzo ntibirimo cookies cyangwa referrer kandi ntibyohereza tokeni ya konti cyangwa amateka yo gusura imbuga.

privacyNoticeReports.message: Raporo zishobora kubamo ikiranga raporo cyakozwe ku buryo bw'impanuka, ibihe byanditswe, verisiyo z'umugereka na mushakisha, ubwoko n'imiterere bya sisitemu y'imikorere, imiterere y'uguhuza n'uburinzi, kode z'amakosa, imibare, igihe byatwaye n'ibisubizo by'igenzura. Raporo zuzuye zishobora kubamo ibikorwa bya tekiniki biheruka. JSON yazo ntirimo amagambobanga, tokeni zo kwemeza, aderesi za imeri, aderesi za IP, URL zasuwe cyangwa domeni zisonewe. Ushobora gusuzuma no kohereza hanze raporo yuzuye mbere yo kuyohereza.

privacyNoticeAccount.message: Raporo zoherezwa kuri FuzeVPN kuri api.fuzevpn.com/v1/diagnostics binyuze mu guhuza kwemejwe. Uku guhuza kwa API ntikunyura muri porokisi ya VPN: FuzeVPN yakira IP yawe rusange itaziguye kabone n'iyo VPN ikora. Raporo zihuzwa na konti yinjiyemo, ntabwo zihishe nyirazo. Umutwe wo kwemeza umwirondoro na IP bitandukanye na JSON ya raporo. Kwakira neza byemeza gusa ko iyo aderesi ya API yemeye raporo, si uko umukozi w'ubufasha yayisomye.

privacyNoticeChoice.message: Kohereza byikora ntibikora ku buryo busanzwe. Kubitangiza byemerera raporo z'amakosa zoroheje z'iyo konti. Kohereza raporo yuzuye n'intoki bisaba kuranga agasanduku ko kohereza. Firefox nayo isaba uruhushya rwayo rw'amakuru ya tekiniki rutari itegeko. Zimya kohereza byikora kugira ngo ubihagarike kandi usibe raporo zikora zitegereje; hagarika ukwabyo buri kohereza gutegereje. Kwanga kohereza isuzuma ntibikubuza gukoresha VPN.

privacyNoticeDelete.message: Mu Isuzuma, siba amateka ya tekiniki cyangwa usibe raporo imwe ibitswe hano. Gusiba amateka ntibisiba kopi za raporo zisanzweho. Guhagarika cyangwa gusiba hano ntibishobora kugarura amakuru serivisi yamaze kwakira, harimo n'ayoherejwe mbere y'uko uhagarika. Dosiye zakuruwe ni dosiye zitandukanye ugomba kwisibira ubwawe.

privacyNoticeServer.message: Uyu mugereka ntugenzura kandi ntiwemeza ibikwa kuri seriveri cyangwa isiba rikorerwa kuri seriveri. Ku gihe cyo kubika gikoreshwa na FuzeVPN no ku byifuzo bijyanye na raporo zamaze koherezwa, reba politiki rusange y'ubuzima bwite cyangwa uvugane na FuzeVPN. Iri tangazo ntiryemeza igihe ntakuka cyo kubika kuri seriveri.

privacyNoticeSupport.message: Kohereza raporo y'isuzuma ubwabyo ntibyohereza ubutumwa ku bufasha buvuye mu mugereka. Kugira ngo usobanure ikibazo cyangwa usabe gusiba raporo yakiriwe, koresha uburyo bwo kuvugana na FuzeVPN buri hepfo. Niba uhisemo gusangiza dosiye yoherejwe hanze unyuze mu bundi buryo, banza urebe ibiyirimo.
